b405_dialog:
Lock "Lead" to the chip?

This track's fader is at −6.0 dB and its pan at 20R. Locking resets it to 0 dB and centre: a locked track's level comes from the chip itself. Unlocking puts them back.
b406_warn_unlock: dev: warning Switch the hardware profile to NES (2A03)? | NES (2A03) doesn't have the channels these locked tracks use: /  / "Shine" (VRC6 Pulse 1) /  / Unlock them to keep them playing as studio tracks, or switch anyway: they stay locked, dimmed and silent until you switch back.

b407_warn_fit: dev: warning A locked track plays one note at a time | "Pulse 1" (2A03 Pulse 1): this edit makes a chord or overlapping notes, which the real chip can't play. /  / Unlock the track to keep the chord (a studio track, unlimited voices), or fit it to the hardware: each note is cut where the next one starts (the last note wins).
